name: Hemp Wraps Assorted
description: Hemp Wraps are the perfect go-to when seeking a refined and clean wrap for your legal blends. Each pack houses two 100% tobacco-free hemp wraps with included packing straws. Reseal your pack for later use and keep your wraps as fresh as the day you opened them with the resealable packaging! These smooth and slow burning wraps deliver an exceptional draw and also come in a variety of flavors to fit your smoking style.
